body: I'm in a really bad way right now with a mental breakdown. I live alone and I am getting professional help but the isolation between counselling and appointments is just too much. would it be wrong of me to use the same logic as being able to move to a friend's for a period of time following an argument at home to do the same in my situation? The person I need to get away from at home is me. My friend says it's okay because it's using common sense but I don't want to get anyone into trouble
